_readme: Drop the real files next to this manifest under the filenames below; no code changes are needed. Missing files keep their placeholder. Sizes are the expected pixel dimensions. Videos: muted, looping, H.264 MP4 (optional WebM), 15 s or less for phone clips. Images: PNG, WebP or JPG. See landing/README.md.
